# Database Schema & Models (Tier 0)

Define Prisma models for core domain: User, StyleProfile, Product, Post, Creator, Vendor, Order, WardrobeItem, RefreshToken.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prisma schema updated with required models and relations.
- Migrations generated and applied locally.
- Seed script to populate initial content for staging.

Success metric: DB schema applied in staging and seed script completes.
